criteria.rule: Key, constraints, and explanations must match visible workflow outcomes; do not add external delivery, payment capture, or retry guarantees absent from the case.

warningReceipt.disposition: Non-blocking; semantic option review still performed.

findings.evidence: Alt2 authorizes payment before securing a charger slot. The prompt distinguishes authorization from charging; the feedback's claim that this may debit the driver is unsupported.
findings.requiredCorrection: Diagnose the risk of an authorization without capacity, and retain the separate diagnosis of a hold stranded after decline.

findings.evidence: The prompt does not state delayed receipt or a way to determine whether the external clinic received the send. The statement that the identifier can be checked against the prior send adds delivery-status knowledge.
findings.requiredCorrection: Keep the same local referral identity on a retry but do not imply the ID alone proves delivery or recipient-side deduplication; alternatively make delivery-status behavior visible in the stem.

findings.evidence: The scenario says the order remains settled but unpaid after bank rejection, so 'Settle only on bank confirmation' is ambiguous or contradictory. The constraint applies the payout ID to delayed-response retries generally, while the stem and wrong-option feedback limit it to report-update retries.
findings.requiredCorrection: Clarify that payout completion/release is recorded only on bank confirmation, and limit same-ID retry language to the report update without implying bank-side deduplication.
